title: AI in Research — Useful Helper, Dangerous Authority

hook.en: AI can summarise ten papers in a minute, and it can invent a paper that never existed in the same breath. For a student or clinician, AI is a fast, tireless assistant that sometimes lies confidently. Learn what it is good for, what it must never be trusted with, and how to check everything.
hook.ur: AI ek minute mein das papers ka khulasa kar sakta hai, aur usi saans mein aisa paper gharh sakta hai jo kabhi tha hi nahi. Talib-e-ilm ya clinician ke liye AI tez, na thakne wala madadgar hai jo kabhi kabhi itminan se jhoot bolta hai. Seekhein yeh kis kaam ke liye achha hai, kis par is par kabhi bharosa nahi karna, aur har cheez kaise jaanchni hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll use AI tools for safe tasks (brainstorming, plain-language explanation, drafting search words), spot hallucinated references and claims, verify every fact against the original source, protect patient data and follow journal rules on disclosing AI.
goal.ur: End tak aap AI aalon ko mehfooz kaamon (khayal sochna, saade alfaaz mein wazahat, search alfaaz ka draft) ke liye istemal karenge, gharay hue hawale aur daawe pehchanenge, har haqeeqat asal zariye se jaanchenge, mareez ka data mehfooz rakhenge aur AI ke elaan par journal ke qaide follow karenge.

text.en: **Large language models** (such as chatbots) predict plausible words; they do not look up facts. So they can produce fluent text with **hallucinations**: wrong statistics, invented references with real-looking authors and DOIs, and confident answers to questions that have no good answer. They also reflect biases in their training data and may be out of date. Good uses are **starting points** that you then check; poor uses are anything where an unverified answer reaches a patient or a paper.
text.ur: **Large language models** (jaise chatbots) mumkina alfaaz ki peshgoi karte hain; woh haqaiq dhoondhte nahi. Isliye woh rawan text paida kar sakte hain jis mein **hallucinations** hoti hain: ghalat shumariyat, asal jaise musannifon aur DOIs wale gharay hue hawale, aur aise sawalon ke itminan bhare jawab jin ka koi achha jawab nahi. Woh training data ke biases bhi zahir karte hain aur purane ho sakte hain. Achhe istemal **aaghaz ke nuqtay** hain jinhein aap phir jaanchte hain; kharab istemal woh hain jahan be-tasdeeq jawab mareez ya paper tak pohanche.

text.en: Think of **a very confident new intern**. They are quick, polite and eager, and they sometimes make things up rather than say "I don't know". You would happily ask them to draft a list of ideas, but you would never let them sign a prescription without checking. Treat AI the same way.
text.ur: **Bohat pur-aitmaad naye intern** ko sochein. Woh tez, shaista aur josheela hai, aur kabhi kabhi "mujhe nahi pata" kehne ke bajaye baatein gharh leta hai. Aap khushi se un se khayalat ki fehrist ka draft karwa lenge, lekin bina jaanche unhein nuskha kabhi dastakhat nahi karne denge. AI ke saath bhi aisa hi sulook karein.

title.en: Safe uses and risky uses of AI in research
title.ur: Research mein AI ke mehfooz aur khatarnak istemal

rows.en: Use freely, then test ideas with a real search and your supervisor
rows.ur: Be-jhijak istemal karein, phir asal search aur supervisor se ideas aazmayein

rows.en: Explaining a concept in plain words

rows.ur: Darmiyana: halki ghalti ho sakti hai

rows.en: Cross-check with a textbook or a review; use it to understand, not to cite
rows.ur: Kitab ya review se milayein; samajhne ke liye istemal karein, hawala dene ke liye nahi

rows.en: Test each suggested term in PubMed or PEDro and keep what works
rows.ur: Har tajweez shuda lafz PubMed ya PEDro mein aazmayein aur jo kaam kare rakhein

rows.en: High: may omit or invent details
rows.ur: Zyada: tafseel chhor ya gharh sakta hai

rows.en: Upload only papers you may share; read the original methods and results yourself
rows.ur: Sirf woh papers dein jinhein share karne ki ijazat ho; asal methods aur nateeje khud parhein

rows.en: Never copy; find every paper in a database and read it
rows.ur: Kabhi copy na karein; har paper database mein dhoondhein aur parhein
Mareez ke data wali koi cheez

rows.en: Do not enter identifiable data into public tools
rows.ur: Pehchan karwane wala data aam aalon mein na dalein

question.en: An AI chatbot gives you five references on exercise for neck pain, with authors, journal names and DOIs. What must you do before using them?
question.ur: AI chatbot aap ko gardan dard ke liye exercise par paanch hawale deta hai, musannifon, journal ke naam aur DOIs ke saath. Istemal se pehle aap ko kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Trust them if the journal names are real
text.ur: Agar journal ke naam asal hon to bharosa karein

feedback.en: A real journal does not make the article real.
feedback.ur: Asal journal ka matlab article asal nahi.

text.en: Search for each paper in PubMed or the journal site, confirm it exists, and read it to check it says what the chatbot claims
text.ur: Har paper PubMed ya journal ki site par dhoondhein, tasdeeq karein ke maujood hai, aur parh kar dekhein ke woh wahi kehta hai jo chatbot ne kaha

feedback.en: Yes — AI can invent plausible-looking references.
feedback.ur: Haan — AI asal jaise lagne wale hawale gharh sakta hai.

text.en: Cite them directly because they look real
text.ur: Seedha hawala dein kyunke asal lagte hain

question.en: Which of these is a safe thing to put into a public AI tool?
question.ur: In mein se kaun si cheez aam AI aale mein dalna mehfooz hai?

text.en: A general question such as "explain the difference between sensitivity and specificity in simple words"
text.ur: Aam sawal jaise "sensitivity aur specificity ka farq saade alfaaz mein samjhayein"

feedback.en: Yes — no personal or confidential data are involved.
feedback.ur: Haan — koi zaati ya raaz ka data shamil nahi.

text.en: A patient's full notes with their name and address
text.ur: Mareez ke poore notes naam aur pate ke saath

text.en: An unpublished manuscript that is not yours to share
text.ur: Ghair shaya shuda manuscript jo aap ka share karne ka nahi

feedback.ur: Yeh raaz daari tod sakta hai.

question.en: A journal asks whether AI was used to prepare your manuscript. What is the right approach?
question.ur: Journal poochhta hai ke manuscript tayyar karne mein AI istemal hua ya nahi. Sahi tareeqa kya hai?

text.en: List the chatbot as a co-author
Hide it, because nobody can tell
text.ur: Chhupayein, kyunke koi nahi bata sakta

feedback.en: Hiding it breaks journal rules and trust.
feedback.ur: Chhupana journal ke qaide aur bharosa todta hai.

text.en: Follow the journal's policy, disclose how AI was used, and remember that AI cannot be an author and that you remain responsible for everything in the paper
text.ur: Journal ki policy follow karein, batayein AI kaise istemal hua, aur yaad rakhein ke AI musannif nahi ban sakta aur paper ki har cheez ki zimmedari aap ki hai

feedback.en: Yes — responsibility and transparency stay with the human authors.
feedback.ur: Haan — zimmedari aur shaffafiyat insani musannifon ke paas rehti hai.

text.en: **Treating fluent text as true text.** AI answers sound confident whether they are right or wrong, so style is not evidence. The most common failures are invented references, wrong numbers and old information. A second trap is letting AI write your methods or results: it cannot know what you actually did. Use it for ideas and drafts, and make every fact yours by checking it.
text.ur: **Rawan text ko sachcha text samajhna.** AI ke jawab sahi hon ya ghalat pur-aitmaad lagte hain, isliye andaaz saboot nahi. Sab se aam nakamiyan gharay hue hawale, ghalat numbers aur purani maloomat hain. Doosra jaal AI se apne methods ya nateeje likhwana hai: usay nahi pata aap ne asal mein kya kiya. Isay khayalat aur draft ke liye istemal karein, aur har haqeeqat jaanch kar apni banayein.

text.en: **Use the "verify, cite, disclose, protect" routine.** Verify every fact and reference in the original source. Cite the real paper, not the chatbot. Disclose AI use as the journal or university requires. Protect patient and unpublished data by never pasting them into public tools. Keep a short note of what you asked and what you changed, so you can explain it later.
text.ur: **"Jaanchein, hawala dein, elaan karein, mehfooz rakhein" ki routine istemal karein.** Har haqeeqat aur hawala asal zariye mein jaanchein. Asal paper ka hawala dein, chatbot ka nahi. AI ke istemal ka elaan jaisa journal ya university maange karein. Mareez aur ghair shaya shuda data ko aam aalon mein kabhi paste kar ke mehfooz rakhein. Chhota note rakhein ke aap ne kya poochha aur kya badla, taake baad mein samjha saken.

question.ur: AI aale hawale kyun "hallucinate" karte hain?

answer.en: Language models learn patterns of how references look, such as author names, journal titles, years and DOI formats, and generate a plausible-looking one when asked, whether or not such a paper exists. They have no built-in link to a database that confirms it. Newer tools connected to search engines or databases reduce the problem but do not remove it, which is why you still check the source.
answer.ur: Language models seekhte hain ke hawale kaise dikhte hain, jaise musannifon ke naam, journal ke titles, saal aur DOI ka format, aur maangne par asal jaisa lagne wala bana dete hain, chahe aisa paper ho ya na ho. Un ka kisi aise database se rabt nahi hota jo tasdeeq kare. Search engines ya databases se jure naye aale masla kam karte hain lekin khatam nahi karte, isi liye aap ko phir bhi zariya jaanchna hai.

beats.patient: A student asks a chatbot for studies on "dry needling for plantar heel pain" and receives four references. She searches PubMed: two exist, one has the right title but a different year and author, and one cannot be found.
beats.assessment: Half the references are wrong or fabricated, though all looked genuine.
beats.treatment: She keeps only the two verified papers, reads them in full, finds the real search words in their abstracts, and runs her own PubMed search.
beats.reassess: Her literature review rests on real sources, and she mentions in her methods that AI was used for brainstorming search terms only.

text.en: **Never let AI advice reach a patient unchecked.** A wrong dose, a wrong exercise or a missed red flag from a chatbot can harm. Use AI for learning and drafting, not for deciding care, and always confirm clinical information in a guideline, a reliable textbook or with a senior colleague. Do not give patients AI answers as if they were your own judgement.
text.ur: **AI ka mashwara mareez tak bina jaanche kabhi na pohanchne dein.** Chatbot ki ghalat dose, ghalat exercise ya chhooti hui red flag nuqsan kar sakti hai. AI ko seekhne aur draft ke liye istemal karein, care ka faisla karne ke liye nahi, aur clinical maloomat hamesha guideline, bharosemand kitab ya kisi senior saathi se tasdeeq karein. Mareezon ko AI ke jawab aise na dein jaise woh aap ka apna judgement ho.

text.en: A review in Nature Medicine described the opportunities of large language models in medicine, such as summarising and drafting text, alongside challenges including the risk of inaccurate or biased outputs, privacy and the need for human oversight and evaluation. A report on artificial hallucinations in scientific writing showed that a widely used chatbot produced fabricated references and details in answers to medical questions, with fluent text that could mislead readers unless checked.
text.ur: Nature Medicine ke ek review ne medicine mein large language models ke mawaqe bayan kiye, jaise text ka khulasa aur draft, saath mein challenges jaise ghalat ya biased nateejon ka khatra, nijiyat aur insani nigrani aur jaanch ki zaroorat. Science likhne mein artificial hallucinations par ek report ne dikhaya ke ek wasi istemal hone wale chatbot ne tibbi sawalon ke jawab mein gharay hue hawale aur tafseelat paida kiye, rawan text ke saath jo jaanche baghair parhne walon ko gumrah kar sakte thay.

text.en: **Verify, Cite, Disclose, Protect.** Check every fact, cite the real source, disclose AI use, and protect patient data.
text.ur: **Jaanchein, Hawala dein, Elaan, Mehfooz.** Har haqeeqat jaanchein, asal zariye ka hawala dein, AI ke istemal ka elaan karein, aur mareez ka data mehfooz rakhein.

summary.en: AI is a fast helper for ideas, explanations and search words, but it can invent references, numbers and facts.
summary.ur: AI khayalat, wazahat aur search alfaaz ke liye tez madadgar hai, lekin hawale, numbers aur haqaiq gharh sakta hai.

summary.en: Verify every claim in the original source and never paste patient or unpublished data into public tools.
summary.ur: Har daawe ko asal zariye mein jaanchein aur mareez ya ghair shaya shuda data aam aalon mein kabhi na dalein.

summary.en: Follow journal rules on disclosure; AI cannot be an author and you remain responsible.
summary.ur: Elaan par journal ke qaide follow karein; AI musannif nahi ban sakta aur zimmedari aap ki hai.

back.en: Fluent output that is wrong or invented, such as a fake reference.
back.ur: Rawan lekin ghalat ya gharha hua nateeja, jaise jhoota hawala.

front.ur: Kya AI musannif ban sakta hai?

back.en: No; authors must be accountable humans.
back.ur: Nahi; musannif zimmedar insaan hone chahiyen.

front.en: What must you do with every AI-provided reference?
front.ur: AI ke diye har hawale ka kya karna hai?

back.en: Find the paper in a database and read it.
back.ur: Paper ko database mein dhoondhein aur parhein.

front.en: What should never go into a public AI tool?
front.ur: Aam AI aale mein kya kabhi nahi dalna chahiye?

back.en: Identifiable patient data or unpublished confidential work.
back.ur: Pehchan karwane wala mareez ka data ya ghair shaya shuda raaz ka kaam.

note.ur: Jo aap chhapte hain us ki zimmedari.
